description:
Cha-Ching gives indie founders and small software businesses an immediate signal when money reaches the payment sources they already use.

Connect Stripe through its provider-hosted, read-only authorization flow or create a private custom webhook for another payment source. When a successful payment arrives, Cha-Ching records it in your Payments feed and sends a recognizable alert to your iPhone.

Version 1.0 includes:
• Secure Sign in with Apple
• Read-only Stripe connection and verified Stripe payment alerts
• Private custom webhook payment sources
• Configurable notification fields and genuine notification tests
• Payment history, source pause controls, and notification preferences

Custom-webhook payments are reported by whoever possesses the source's private URL and are not independently verified by Cha-Ching. Provider credentials are never stored on your iPhone. Cha-Ching is not accounting, banking, payout, reconciliation, tax, or financial-advice software.
